successors.name: Holy Roman Empire (1260-1806)
successors.text: the duchy's office 'had been fully subsumed into the office of the king'

successors.name: Duchy of Württemberg
successors.text: Conradin pledged his Swabian inheritance to Ulrich II, count of Wurttemberg

ledger.x: 1260: the last Hohenstaufen hold the Duchy of Swabia.
1268: Conradin is executed at Naples and the Hohenstaufen duchy ends.

wars.name: Conradin's campaign against Charles of Anjou (Tagliacozzo)
wars.outcome: Conradin is defeated at Tagliacozzo in 1268 and executed at Naples; the direct line of the dukes of Swabia ceases.

certainty.note: A ducal territory with no surveyed edge on either page; the Alsatian, Lech and Alpine limits are approximate.
